scenes.conflict: Tavin argues that the inscription settles the matter, and Ilyra's instinct to withhold information prevents them from comparing what each has seen.
scenes.goal: Ilyra aims to verify whether the changed letter is recent before the Court settles the succession.
scenes.outcome: Ilyra identifies evidence of a recent alteration but leaves without sharing it; Tavin treats her silence as weakness and pushes to have the claim decided quickly.
scenes.summary: Ilyra examines the salt-etched genealogy in the Salt Crypt and distinguishes the changed letter from the older cuts around it. Tavin presses her to accept that the record disqualifies her, while she keeps her doubts and observations to herself.
scenes.title: The Altered Descent

scenes.conflict: Tavin wants a clear victory, while Orrin's plan depends on keeping the outcome unsettled and each branch beholden.
scenes.goal: Orrin aims to protect the Compact's leverage over both sides of the succession dispute.
scenes.outcome: Tavin accepts continued support but sees that Orrin benefits from delay; the loan terms give him a reason to scrutinize the Compact's role.
scenes.summary: In Bellward Nave, Orrin reviews the Compact's loans with Tavin and confirms that both branches contesting Ilyra's claim depend on Giltwake favors. He offers to preserve Tavin's position, expecting the unresolved succession to keep both sides indebted.
scenes.title: Both Sides in Debt

scenes.conflict: Sere's secrecy leaves Ilyra without the explanation she needs, while Ilyra's guarded manner makes Sere doubt that she will share any account fairly.
scenes.goal: Ilyra aims to learn whether the toll can verify her descent without making the Court's authority depend on silencing the Cantors.
scenes.outcome: Sere agrees only to observe the next toll and report what it reveals about the record's limits; Ilyra must decide whether to risk sharing her own evidence first.
scenes.summary: At Choirwell Exchange, Ilyra asks Sere to interpret the toll patterns and explain what they can establish about the changed record. Sere refuses to speak plainly, afraid their rites will be bought and used by the Court or Compact.
scenes.title: A Limited Account

scenes.conflict: Her fear that disclosure will make her complicit in a manipulated lineage leads her to reveal too little; Orrin uses the resulting uncertainty to encourage more borrowing and delay.
scenes.goal: Ilyra aims to challenge the claim that the crypt inscription alone settles her inheritance.
scenes.outcome: The Court does not settle the claim, and Orrin gains another opening to preserve his leverage. Ilyra recognizes that withholding evidence is prolonging the very arrangement she opposes.
scenes.summary: Ilyra brings her observations to Bellward Nave, where Tavin and Orrin are preparing to press the succession issue. She begins to disclose the altered cuts, then holds back the detail that could undermine the Court's certainty.
scenes.title: Evidence in the Nave

scenes.conflict: The new alteration undermines the record, while Tavin's belief that preserving order means defending the Court makes an honest account seem dangerous.
scenes.goal: Tavin aims to determine whether the crypt's records can still support his branch's succession claim.
scenes.outcome: Tavin admits privately to Sere that he saw the letter change. Sere confirms only that the toll altered the record, not that it proves either heir's descent.
scenes.summary: As the buried bells toll in the Salt Crypt, the trench current shifts and a letter in the record changes before Tavin's eyes. He cannot claim the inscription is stable, but his instinct to preserve Court order makes him hesitate to admit what he witnessed.
scenes.title: A Letter Changes

scenes.conflict: Sere fears that public testimony will expose the Cantors to political use, while Tavin must choose between protecting his branch's advantage and acknowledging the change he witnessed.
scenes.goal: Ilyra aims to prevent the Vellum Court from treating a changeable inscription as decisive proof, and Sere aims to explain the toll without claiming more than they know.
scenes.outcome: Tavin confirms the alteration before the Court's gathered representatives. The competing claims remain unresolved, but neither branch can honestly present the inscription as unquestionable proof.
scenes.summary: In Bellward Nave, Ilyra openly presents her reading of the altered cuts and invites Sere to explain what the toll can establish. Sere gives a careful account: the record changed, but the toll cannot certify either claimant's descent.
scenes.title: The Toll's Limits

scenes.conflict: Orrin's belief that every conviction can be turned into a bargain has prolonged the conflict; revealing the loan terms risks his standing and weakens his control.
scenes.goal: Orrin aims to preserve the Compact's position in the settlement, while Ilyra aims to expose how financing has distorted the succession dispute.
scenes.outcome: Orrin makes the terms public, surrendering the secrecy that protected his leverage. Ilyra refuses to claim that the evidence proves her inheritance, insisting instead that the Court cannot decide it by a record known to change.
scenes.summary: Orrin confronts Ilyra after her testimony threatens the Compact's influence. Seeing that private bargains will only deepen suspicion, he reveals the terms of his loans to both branches, including how repayment in favors due at a toll rewards continued uncertainty.
scenes.title: The Price of Delay

scenes.conflict: Tavin still wants his branch to prevail, and the Court must confront a succession with no unquestionable record; Orrin can no longer quietly steer both sides through undisclosed loans.
scenes.goal: Ilyra aims to challenge the Court's reliance on the inscription without demanding recognition unsupported by the evidence.
scenes.outcome: The claim remains contested, but the Court agrees not to treat the changed letter as conclusive. Tavin competes openly, and Orrin's disclosed terms limit the Compact's ability to profit unseen from delay.
scenes.summary: The Vellum Court reopens the succession dispute in Bellward Nave rather than letting the altered crypt entry settle it. Tavin presents his branch's case openly, and Ilyra accepts that a fair contest may cost her the title.
scenes.title: No Easy Heir

scenes.conflict: The salt preserves records for centuries, but a future toll may alter a letter again; both must accept that their account cannot settle the underlying lineage.
scenes.goal: Ilyra and Sere aim to leave an honest account that neither turns the toll into proof nor hides the change from future scrutiny.
scenes.outcome: They preserve a shared record of what was observed and what remains unknown. Ilyra accepts that truth may cost her title, and Sere allows their testimony to stand beyond the Cantors' private rites.
scenes.summary: Ilyra and Sere return to the Salt Crypt to preserve an account of the altered record and the limits of the toll's meaning. Ilyra shares her observations rather than keeping them as private protection, while Sere records what they witnessed without claiming to know the full truth.
scenes.title: What the Salt Keeps

logline: With the next bell toll threatening to alter the Salt Crypt's record again, disputed heir Ilyra Vell must expose what the changing inscription can—and cannot—prove before Orrin Gilt's loans turn uncertainty into lasting control of the Vellum succession.
theme: Truth shared imperfectly can challenge power built on useful uncertainty.
title: The Name Beneath the Toll
